name: Fablery
description:
About This Game

Fablery is a tactical game blending chess and card-based strategy.

Take control of Heroes inspired by myths and legends from around the world as they clash on a board.
Master the abilities of iconic figures like Hades, Alice, Cleopatra, and many more.

Every Hero has a unique deck that reflects their personality, universe, and powers.
Turn the tide of battle through your tactical decisions.

In Fablery, build your strategy using your cards. Deploy powerful units, cast spells, and create countless strategic combinations. Protect your Hero at all costs, set traps, or go all in, choose how you approach each battle.

  • Face opponents in intense 1v1 battles.

  • Complete solo thematic missions built around your favorite heroes.

  • Team up with a friend and fight another duo in 2v2 mode.

  • Solve progressively more challenging puzzles.

Whether you love card games, tactical combat, or timeless myths, Fablery offers a unique, accessible experience filled with unforgettable duels.
short_desc: Take control of legendary Heroes from myths, tales, and legends of every culture. Each Hero has a unique deck reflecting their personality and powers. Enter a tactical card game where strategy and foresight turn every battle into an unforgettable story.
